outing.hero_prompt_english: Zhoukoudian Site Museum in Fangshan: a modern low angular building with faceted earth-colored stone cladding inspired by fractured stone tools, museum forecourt and low limestone hills beyond. An adult visitor holds a small guidebook; foreground contains abstract archaeological stone-tool and sediment-layer study motifs, no human remains, skeletons or frightening scenes. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
